data.name: ETA: Unknown
data.detailed_description:
ETA: Unknown is a cockpit-driven psychological horror game that plunges you into the frozen desolation of Antarctica. When contact with multiple research sites suddenly vanishes without obvious cause, you're sent in alone to investigate.

Piloting a utility rover across a barren, snow-lashed wasteland, you must contend with brutal cold, failing machinery, and a growing sense that something unseen is watching. Your only tools are the crude systems in your vehicle and your own determination to uncover the truth: and make it out in one piece.

Features

Tactile Controls

Flip switches, push buttons, and operate your rover with precise, hands-on mouse controls and diegetic interfaces.

Survival and Exploration

Navigate hostile, snow covered dunes as you struggle to manage component health, fuel, and harsh weather. Investigate the nature of operations of the research colony, but be mindful: some things buried in the ice were never meant to be found.

Maintenance

One wrong move can cause systems to degrade or fail, stranding you in the cold with no help coming. 

Atmosphere

Cinematic lighting, music and UI inspired by early personal computing create an atmosphere rooted in horror movies of the 80s.

data.short_description: ETA: Unknown is a psychological horror game set deep within frozen dunes of Antarctica. When remote research sites fall silent without explanation, you're sent on a lone reconnaissance mission – into silence, cold and something far bigger than you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: i5-3470 / Ryzen 3 1300
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 / RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: "High" graphics preset targetting 1080p@60FPS. Graphics driver with full support for Vulkan 1.0.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: i5-9600k / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: "Ultra" graphics preset targetting 1440p@60FPS.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains horror themes, references to medical procedures and mental illness, and non-graphic mentions of suicide and self-harm.
